Need for Speed Underground / VLC parity pass

Original: The Skins Factory / Electronic Arts (2003).
VLC conversion: Dead Signal Interactive.

Install VLC, extract the complete bundle, then run Start-1x.cmd or Start-2x.cmd
for sounds, framed hover and the native dial-volume OSD interface. These use
private per-scale settings and refuse to replace an already running launch.
Preview-1x.cmd / Preview-2x.cmd are skin-only intro previews, without the helper
or volume interface. They rewrite only adjacent separate settings files.
1x matches the source 300x298 size.
2x is 600x596 with independently resampled sprite frames. Lossless animation
bands measured about 3.5 seconds at 1x / 18 seconds at 2x on the prior
native-tested build. This compact candidate passes offline checks only;
earlier native fullscreen findings apply to their recorded older hashes.
Native initialization, compact hover and volume OSD display remain pending.
The original intro sequence is about 8 seconds.

For your regular VLC profile: Tools > Preferences > Interface > Use custom
skin, choose a VLT, save and restart VLC.

Clock toggles elapsed/remaining. Color cycles seven palettes. The star opens
the video panel. List/bars open playlist/EQ. Information opens the original
menu; its footer includes conversion credits and Replay intro. Normal VLC
launches can restore a saved layout without the intro; preview launchers
reset it before starting VLC (native recheck pending). Replay selects the blue palette.

Read PARITY.md, VERIFICATION.md and native-gui-review.json for supported behavior and pending checks.
This bundle is ready for hands-on review; 100% acceptance is not yet certified.

Compact controls stay 360x64 on both scales, use original small buttons and
expand volume on hover (speaker click fallback). The framed strip uses 85%
opacity. Main filenames use larger white text. No running skin was updated
by preparing this bundle. See COMPACT-CONTROLS.md and compact-review.json.

The original 18-second imode.wav accompanies static Info artwork, not a video
or slideshow. Original short page/frame fades are still a parity gap;
see INFO-SOURCE-AUDIT.md. Framed hover mouse-wheel routing also remains open.

Fresh positions fit work areas of 1280x720 at 1x and 1920x1040 at 2x.
Existing saved VLC positions may override them. The shutter uses static
original feedback with a separate 500 ms gate to prevent hover-delay restarts.

Video sizing audit: media dimensions no longer enlarge the framed panel;
manual resizing remains available. VIDEO-SIZING.md and visual-comparison.json
separate offline source/render evidence from the remaining native checks.

Lower-right corner fix: matching original corner artwork replaces the black
resize hit bitmap at both scales. See CORNER-FIX.md. Running or derived
YouTube skins must be regenerated from this VLT and reloaded to see the fix.

Shutter isolation: pane color no longer follows shutter/clock layout changes.
See SHUTTER-ISOLATION.md for the limited native retest and one-time migration
of existing saved colored profiles. Review launchers reset their own profiles.

Framed fullscreen: fullscreen and video plus buttons fill the monitor with
the original skin border; click again to restore. Double-click native video
for borderless fullscreen. Both scales passed targeted live blue-palette tests
at 1920x1080, including restore and stopped-header appearance. See FULLSCREEN.md
and VIDEO-REPAINT.md. Other monitors/palettes and full parity remain unverified.
